name: Solution Sketching (4-Step)

steps.text: Run four timed beats: gather, ideate, riff, then sketch.
Review framing and research silently, taking notes only.
Diagram flows, then riff the strongest idea eight times.
Finish with a three-panel storyboard a stranger follows.
Hang the anonymous sketches for a silent read.

failure: Half-working looks like arrows and empty boxes only the author can narrate: the idea dies.
intervention: Ask whether a stranger could follow the sketch without you, then add headlines and labels until they can.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.
